turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Of course.

Remember: subject + verb + object. Always/usually/often go before the main verb.
Example: We usually have lunch at one.

Exercise: Put in order:
"usually / we / lunch / have"
